visualCharacteristics.purpose: Rich-text content with an optional image or gradient highlight box
visualCharacteristics.layout: Media row above the text by default; media floated left or right beside the text with left/right, at 50% (half) or 33% (third) width
notable: Text-only media cell becomes a gradient highlight box
Leading h2/h3 becomes the row headline in floated variants
CTA paragraphs become a button row
third variant adds inline arrows to rich-text links

contentPattern.structure: optional media cell (picture or short statement), then a text cell with headings, paragraphs, lists and optional CTA links

usage: Use for a body text section, optionally paired with an image or highlighted statement.
reuseGuidance: Fits one text column with at most one media item; not for multiple equal columns or repeating cards.
